meta.recall10: stable descending order, top ceil(0.1 n) as executed_source.py; recall10_expected = tie-aware expectation

F3_nvd_before_origin.definition: pre-public = advisory nvd_published_at <= origin 23:59:59.999Z; advisories without nvd_published_at are counted as not pre-public
F3_nvd_before_origin.primary: drop_all_pre_public_positives (rows removed from train and test); others are secondary

F22_severity.definition: max severity over matched advisories (GHSA severity field; medium = moderate); outcome sensitivity label=1 iff any matched advisory is high or critical, else 0; models refit on that label

F19_multiplicity.method: package-cluster bootstrap (np.unique cluster order, rng default_rng(42) per origin, 1,000 draws, skip draws without both classes) as executed_source.intervals; p = min(1, 2*min((#<=0 + 1)/(n+1), (#>=0 + 1)/(n+1))) (p_raw without +1); Holm within each family of nine

F11_lockfile.method: paired package-cluster bootstrap over the matched lockfile subset (same rows in both arms; labels may differ); difference = recorded - inferred; 1,000 draws, seed 42 per origin; test-set uncertainty only (models fitted separately per arm, training variation not included)

F14_semver_versions_behind.finding: No semver-ordered versions-behind exists: src/semver_variants.cjs changes only the latest-version rule; the count loop (releases after used_version_date in date order, reference advanced only on a semver increase) is identical in every variant, and the semver_* datasets have identical major/minor/patch columns to date_12_paired (0 differing rows).

F20_pit.note: values in pit_results.json are rounded to 4 dp at source; 2021-12-31 origin not checkable (history starts Feb 2022)
